title: Spatial Mediaguide
shortDescription: A location-aware QR/NFC guide that delivers relevant stories, facts, and media based on each visitor’s position, language, and profile, directly on their phone.
longDescription: A smart companion that enriches physical spaces with contextual information in multiple languages, easily adaptable for different audiences or themes. Whether it's an exhibition, brand activation, or venue tour, it connects visitors with stories, facts, and narratives directly tied to their journey for maximum accessibility and engagement.

highlights.title: Seamless Onboarding & Multilingual Entry
highlights.description: Visitors enter the experience effortlessly by scanning a QR code or tapping via NFC, with no app download required. A short welcome flow introduces the journey and lets users select their preferred language, setting the foundation for a personalized experience. The same entry points can support multiple audiences, from kids to expert groups, by simply switching the underlying “story” without changing any physical setup.

highlights.title: Flexible Mediaguide with Text & Images
highlights.description: The default mediaguide delivers rich, structured content combining text, images, and contextual storytelling directly on the visitor’s device. It adapts to any topic, from exhibitions to brand spaces or tours, and can be easily reconfigured for different narratives or depths of information. Whether for families, guided groups, or individual exploration, the same system supports multiple layers of content without altering the access points.

highlights.title: Audio & Video Companion Experiences
highlights.description: Beyond text, the mediaguide expands into immersive audio and video formats, turning each location into a multimedia touchpoint. Visitors can listen to narrated stories or watch contextual clips that deepen understanding and engagement. Content formats can be mixed and matched freely, allowing you to tailor experiences for different audiences or themes while keeping the same QR codes or NFC triggers in place.

highlights.title: Triggers, Quizzes & AR
highlights.description: Swap the trigger to fit the space: keep QR and NFC, or layer in GPS and beacon proximity so content unlocks as visitors move. Add a quiz at each stop, a scan-them-all collectible challenge, AR overlays, bookmarking, or auto-play narration. Each upgrade slots in as a clean paid add-on that keeps repeat installs feeling new.

highlights.title: One Engine, Any Tour
highlights.description: The same point-to-content engine reskins for any world: a museum exhibition trail, a sustainability route, a brand campus tour, a heritage city walk, or a playful kids' version of an adult guide. Look, voice, and depth all change while the physical setup stays exactly where it is.

highlights.title: Optional Visitor Data
highlights.description: Add an optional data layer that captures scans, language choices, dwell time, media plays, and routes taken. With it in place, clients see which stories land, where visitors linger or drop off, and which languages actually matter, turning a tour into clear engagement evidence and a roadmap for sharper content.

highlights.title: Pairs Across the Journey
highlights.description: Pair with Journey Manager to make each guided stop one node in a longer route. Layer in Trail / Scavenger Hunt to turn the stops into a gamified collect-and-find run, and Visitor Identificator to tie progress and rewards to each profile. Close with Journey Recap so visitors leave with a personalized summary, or The One Big Question to capture a quick reflection at the end.

states.trigger: Visitor scans a QR code or taps an NFC tag at an entry point.
states.experience: A short welcome flow loads on the phone and the visitor picks a language and, where used, a profile.
states.feedback: Branded welcome screen, language picker, brief intro to the journey.
states.configurable: Welcome copy, available languages, profiles, branding, entry points.
states.data: Scan event, entry point, language selected, profile chosen.

states.trigger: Visitor reaches or scans a point of interest.
states.experience: Structured text and images for that location load, tied to the chosen language and depth.
states.feedback: Text, images, and contextual storytelling for the active stop.
states.configurable: Content per stop, depth/layers, theme, ordering, imagery.
states.data: Stop viewed, dwell time, scroll depth, language in use.

states.trigger: Visitor taps an audio or video element at a stop.
states.experience: The visitor listens to narration or watches a contextual clip.
states.feedback: Inline audio or video player with playback controls.
states.configurable: Media assets per stop, autoplay, captions, format mix.
states.data: Plays started, completion rate, format preferred.

states.trigger: Visitor reaches the end of a route or has covered the key stops.
states.experience: A wrap-up screen offers a summary and any next step or call to action.
states.feedback: Completion screen, optional reward, feedback or share prompt.
states.configurable: Summary copy, CTA, reward, feedback prompt, hand-off to other modules.
states.data: Completion rate, full route taken, CTA taps, feedback submitted.
